name: Magnesium Oxide Powder Ash
semanticDescription: Brilliant-white magnesium oxide (MgO) combustion product ash collected in an 80 mm borosilicate watch glass as produced in CBSE Class 10 Chemistry Activity 1.1 (Burning of Magnesium Ribbon). Features dual collections: Magnesium_Oxide_Full (realistic conical ash heap with micro-granules and crumbling combustion flakes in a watch glass on a studio plinth) and Magnesium_Oxide_Detail (180° longitudinal cutaway revealing internal powder bed profile, calipers, an atomic/ionic rock-salt lattice inset demonstrating alternating Mg2+ and O2- ions, and technical reaction plaque).
simplifications: The atomic ionic lattice unit cell is a pedagogical structural inset to connect physical ash powder to its sub-microscopic 1:1 ionic crystal lattice.
